Renee (People Ops): Quick alert: SummitTrust (our 401k vendor for legacy plans) gave notice that they're consolidating small-employer plans into their umbrella product. Cutover window looks like 2024-06-01 to 2024-06-10. They want a successor mapping and signed consents. Anyone on benefits side read the intake spec?
Caleb (Payroll): I got the vendor packet. Key ops concerns: 1) payroll mapping for contributions during the cutover pay periods, 2) how to handle automatic loan repayments that are mid-amortization. Off-cycle remaps are possible but need 72-hour lead time to payroll vendor.
Ivy (Benefits): SummitTrust's ingestion template expects CSV with `ssn,last4,dob,plan_code,pre_tax,after_tax,catchup,loan_balance,loan_id`. They also require a signed participant transfer consent PDF per person. They explicitly note that in-plan Roth conversions will not carry over and will be cashed out as after-tax if not rolled properly.
Marta (Finance): Cashflow question: if distributions occur because transfers fail, taxes/withholding could affect payroll reconciliation. We need to quantify exposure — how many people with loans or recent Roth conversions? Ivy, can you run counts?
Ivy (Benefits): Running now. Preliminary: ~18 participants with active loans, 62 catch-up contributors, 7 recent Roth conversions in last 12 months, 4 international employees flagged (UK/DE/CA).
Renee (People Ops): OK action plan draft: A) Freeze voluntary deferral edits for Summit plan while we execute mapping. B) Export canonical participant file and loan ledger by EOD today. C) Ask SummitTrust and successor whether they accept trustee-to-trustee loan rollovers and e-signed consents. D) Prepare urgent employee note with clear "do not change elections" language and international tax callouts.
Omar (Legal): I'll check the vendor agreement and termination clauses. We may have 60-day notice rights; if SummitTrust is accelerating consolidation, we can push back. Also advise on acceptable consent language and retention for uploaded signed PDFs.
Caleb (Payroll): Practical note: any remap submitted after payroll cutoffs will either (a) be applied next pay period or (b) held as float. We need to identify paydates between 6/1 and 6/10 and plan for an off-cycle if needed. I'll post the pay calendar.
TSO Bot: Pay calendar link: https://intranet.redwood/payroll/2024-pay-calendar --- Next payroll dates around cutover: 2024-05-30, 2024-06-14.
Renee (People Ops): Great — that gives us buffer. Still want to avoid off-cycle. Ivy, please produce a redacted sample CSV for ops to review (no SSNs in Slack, use last4). Example rows OK.
Ivy (Benefits): Sample (redacted) below:
```
employee_id,last4,dob,plan_code,pre_tax,after_tax,catchup,loan_balance,loan_id
20011,4321,1986-03-12,SUM-01,400,0,true,8400,L-1001
20045,9876,1992-11-05,SUM-01,0,0,false,0,
20089,1111,1970-07-02,SUM-01,650,0,true,0,
```
Caleb (Payroll): Looks good. I'll run a mock remap to see what happens if we send the transfer CSV on 6/3 — will notify if off-cycle needed.
Marta (Finance): Also flag: employer match timing. If contributions are delayed during mapping, matching policy says we still match for the payroll period if funds withheld from employee were deposited. We need to ensure deposit windows align so we don't inadvertently miss employer match.
Omar (Legal): On consent: approved short text suggestion: "I authorize Redwood Inference to transfer my retirement account to the successor trustee and to submit required identifying information on my behalf. I understand that certain in-plan Roth conversions or loans may have plan-specific rules and could be handled as taxable distributions if not eligible for transfer." We'll need checkbox consent and retention for 7 years.
Renee (People Ops): Good. Two decisions: 1) Do we centralize collection of signed PDFs? 2) Who owns participant outreach? My vote: central collection + People Ops drafts the urgent email and Benefits handles the FAQ. Any objections?
Ivy (Benefits): Central collection preferred. Successor trustee accepts e-signatures via DocuSign and will accept a zipped batch upload. We'll need to match signed PDF filenames to employee IDs.
Caleb (Payroll): If central, payroll needs a final confirmed CSV at least 72 hours before the payroll cutoff for the pay run that would otherwise send contributions to the old plan. With current calendar, target final mapping by 2024-05-28 COB.
Marta (Finance): I'll model the worst-case cashflow hit if all loans are treated as taxable distributions (unlikely) but need dollar figures by tomorrow.
Ivy (Benefits): I'll start drafting the FAQ. Items to cover: "Why you should not change elections", "What happens to loan repayments", "Roth conversions and conversions history", "International employees", "How to sign and upload consent".
Renee (People Ops): Owners and deadlines: Ivy export + redacted sample by 3pm today; Omar to confirm legal text and retention by 4pm; Caleb to confirm final CSV deadline and mock remap results by 5pm; Marta financial exposure model by EOD tomorrow. I'll draft the urgent note for 6pm send.
Omar (Legal): One more: check whether our QDRO/beneficiary data carries over automatically. I'll include that in the review.
TSO Bot: Reminder set for assignees: @Ivy @Caleb @Omar @Marta check-in at 16:00 today.
Renee (People Ops): Thanks team. I'll keep this thread as the canonical log for leadership updates. :wave:
